title: JB hifi online store

[User #6903515498 postsdoubleshot2Whirlpool Forums Addict] Sadly, JB hifi online store is not to be believed – at least with regard to their advertised stock availability. It seems this part of their website isn't updated to reflect their true stock levels.
I ordered a Sony Bravia 32" 100Hz lcd several days ago. It was a good price and was supposedly in stock and "ready to ship".
Called today as nothing received and my order status hasn't blinked since I placed the order – says "in progress" as it did when I placed the order.
Called the 1300 help number today for an update and I was told they had no stock available and they anticipated it would be a week or so before they receive stock from Sony.
Meanwhile, their web site as I wrote this still says "Stock available and ready to ship". Not true !!!
So a warning to others to take their advertised availability of stock with a large dose of salt.

On the 1st of december I purchased this laptop https://www.jbhifionline.com. au/default.aspx?T=10141&P=466495 online.
As this has not yet been delivered, I searched the net for a contact number
After finally finding a number (you have to call head office on (03) 8530 7333 found here – http://www.asx.com.au/asx/res earch/companyInfo.do?by=asxCode&asxCode=JBH ) then ask to speak to their online department.
I was advised that it was not yet dispatched as they are out of stock and are trying to source more.
If you click on the link about to the laptop. The website is STILL currently advising that this is instock! WFT ?! That is false advertisement!
I am going to ask for them to deliver what ever upgraded model that they have in stock as this is a Christmas present and I need and should of had this delivered by as per their postage T&C's
